kurz: More sugar does not only mean sweeter: baked goods turn more tender, moister, darker and spread more.
bild_im_kopf: A dial between bread and boiled sweet.
was_passiert: [[zucker|Sugar]] binds water, slows [[glutenbildung|gluten]] and protein [[eiweiss-gerinnung|coagulation]], and browns. Less sugar makes baked goods firmer, drier and paler.
faustregeln: Reduce sugar by a quarter at most, otherwise the texture suffers.
More sugar in custards makes them curdle later.

params.rechts: lots of sugar: more tender, moister, darker, spreads more
